analysisInput.observationTimeline: source presentation time mapped from observed proxy and source packet timestamps

positiveControl.purpose: Distinguish a zero-detection fixture result from a model or VIDEO-mode pipeline that is not operating.

sampling.indexRule: Round evenly spaced positions from the first through the last reported proxy frame.

basis.limitation: visual-reference.jsonl does not yet exist; no condition-specific precision or recall is claimed.

smallFaces.interpretation: Visible faces occupied a small part of the 640x360 frame in the reviewed subset. The full-frame short-range configuration returned no fixture detections, but the absence of bbox annotations prevents a condition-specific miss rate.

profileOrNonFrontalFaces.interpretation: Non-frontal views were present in the reviewed subset. Their independent contribution to the zero result is unmeasured.

multiplePeople.interpretation: Frames containing more than one visible person were present in the reviewed subset. No automatic multi-face result was produced, but the exact multi-person miss rate is unmeasured without annotations.

screenShare.interpretation: The 12-frame review did not exercise a screen-share condition, so this failure class remains unmeasured.

configurationDisposition.configuration: MediaPipe 1.0.1, short-range model, full 640x360 proxy frame, confidence 0.5, VIDEO mode
configurationDisposition.reason: The pipeline passed a pinned positive control but supplied no face bbox for any of the 300 fixture samples. This configuration therefore cannot support face-driven reframing on the measured fixture.

stage0Implications: The fixture result is zero detected faces, not evidence that the fixture contains no faces. The positive control confirms that the pinned model and VIDEO-mode pipeline were operating.
The measured full-frame 640x360 short-range configuration must not be the sole input to automatic reframing, subtitle collision avoidance, or thumbnail face scoring for this fixture.

Manual layout modes and manual keyframes remain the required path. Any later automatic path must first measure a changed strategy such as higher-resolution input, a compatible long-range model, or tiled inference against visual-reference annotations.
The 1.154 seconds of model inference and 48.560 seconds of end-to-end benchmark time are measurements on the recorded machine, not cross-machine guarantees.

assessment.interpretation: The mechanism works on a pinned positive image, while the evaluated fixture configuration produces no usable face detections.
measurementCorrections: Run 20260826T2325359389118Z-face-detection-59b47ff9 (SHA-256 05acb711364fccf669535c877e18e0a78e18c75966be5a0b58b4ce0cb6401482) returned zero fixture detections without a positive control. A hash-pinned MediaPipe portrait control was added and the stage was rerun so the zero result could be distinguished from a non-operating detector.
The harness now rejects a successful face-detection payload unless the positive control detects at least one face in VIDEO mode.
openQuestions: Precision, recall, bbox error, and condition-specific miss rates remain unmeasured until visual-reference.jsonl is created independently of model output.
A compatible long-range model, source-resolution sampling, and tiled inference have not been benchmarked as canonical Stage 0 configurations.
Screen-share and material-dominant frames were not observed in the 12-frame technical review and require a separate rights-approved fixture or annotation set.
The final adoption, hold, or manual-only classification is reserved for ST-015 approval.
assessment.privacy: The canonical summary excludes per-frame source times, face boxes, and image pixels. Raw observations remain local and ignored by Git.
